title: Gym Bag Essentials
meta_desc: Discover the must-have items to pack in your gym bag for a successful workout in New Zealand. Get the most out of your gym sessions with our expert guide.
intro: Heading to the gym can be daunting, especially when you're new to working out. One of the most important things to consider is what to pack in your gym bag. In this guide, we'll take you through the essentials to include, what NZ gyms provide, and some helpful tips to keep in mind. Many NZ gyms, such as City Fitness and Les Mills, offer subsidised membership options through Exercise NZ's programme, making it more affordable to get started.

sections.heading: Pre-Workout Essentials
sections.body: Before you start your workout, make sure you have the basics covered. This includes a water bottle, towel, and a change of clothes. Some NZ gyms, like Jetts and Anytime Fitness, provide towel services, but it's always a good idea to bring your own just in case. Don't forget to pack a snack, such as a banana or energy bar, to keep your energy levels up throughout your workout.

sections.heading: Workout Gear
sections.body: The type of workout gear you need will depend on the type of exercise you're doing. If you're planning on doing a strength training session, you may want to bring your own weights or resistance bands. For cardio workouts, a good pair of running shoes is essential. Many NZ gyms, such as Les Mills and City Fitness, offer a range of group fitness classes, so be sure to check what equipment is provided before your class.
list: Yoga mat (if not provided by the gym)

sections.heading: Post-Workout Essentials
sections.body: After your workout, it's essential to refuel and rehydrate. Pack a post-workout snack, such as a protein shake or energy bar, to help your body recover. You should also bring a change of clothes, including a warm top and pants, to change into after your workout. Some NZ gyms, like Jetts and Anytime Fitness, offer shower facilities, so be sure to pack a towel and any other toiletries you may need.
list: Post-workout snack (e.g. protein shake or energy bar)
Towel and toiletries (if using shower facilities)

sections.heading: Locker Tips
sections.body: When using the lockers at your gym, be sure to follow the rules and regulations. Many NZ gyms, such as Les Mills and City Fitness, offer secure lockers with digital locks, but it's still important to keep an eye on your belongings. Be considerate of other gym-goers and keep your locker tidy, and don't forget to take all your belongings with you when you leave.
list: Keep your locker tidy and secure
Take all belongings with you when you leave

sections.heading: Get Started with Your Gym Journey
sections.body: Now that you know what to pack in your gym bag, it's time to get started with your fitness journey. Remember to check out Exercise NZ's subsidised gym scheme, which offers 40-70% off membership prices at participating gyms. With the right gear and a bit of planning, you'll be on your way to a healthier, happier you.
